posts.text: Pro tip: To something that actually makes me move
ADHD will have you doing everything except the thing that actually moves you forward
ADHD wasn’t talked about in my community—only discipline was. This one’s personal.
ADHD hack turns motivation into mystery so I built tools that work with it, not against it.
Overcoming ADHD isn’t about control — it’s about compassion for yourself. Be honest — this one’s you too, right?
ADHD doesn’t mean I can’t focus—it means I can’t *choose* what to focus on.
